import sys

def main():
    import sys
    import bisect

    def read_ints():
        return list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))

    data = read_ints()
    n = data[0]
    T = data[1]
    t = data[2:]

    # Sort the times when the bowls are ready
    t.sort()

    # Initialize the DP array
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)

    # Iterate over each bowl
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        # Find the latest bowl the dog could have skipped to reach bowl i
        j = bisect.bisect_left(t, t[i - 1] - i)
        # Update the DP value for bowl i
        dp[i] = max(dp[i - 1], dp[j] + 1)

    # Find the maximum number of bowls the dog can eat within T seconds
    max_bowls = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        if t[i - 1] + i <= T:
            max_bowls = max(max_bowls, dp[i])

    print(max_bowls)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
